title: The Glass Meridian
subtitle: Someone is selling the same safe passage to two ships at once.
offer: Dock at Avenor after visiting three different systems and identifying two ship types. No kill-count gate or dependency on another campaign.
story: Avenor has recorded three near-collisions on a supposedly certified medical freight lane. Its navigation buoys agree about position but disagree about time. A missing civilian surveyor is being blamed. The real fault is a contractor selling duplicate reservations and disguising the conflict as pilot error. The commander must recover the survey record, rebuild the timing chain and guide a clinic ship through a corrected lane before deciding how to release the evidence.
playerBriefing: Captain Elara Venn: Our clinic convoy cannot launch while two ships can hold the same reservation. Read the beacons at Renas. Look for the surveyor at Navidor. Bring back evidence before deciding who is at fault.
completionBenefit: A public lane-safety commendation and the selected evidence outcome in regional gossip. No fabricated combat points or automatic ship blueprint. A permanent clue for The Unwritten Route: The missing instant.

branchPolicy: Record the selected evidence/protocol outcome in pack state and gossip. Branches reconverge at the next stage and share the advertised base payment.
identityPolicy: Match locations by galaxy/system identity, not coordinates or displayed spelling. Match entities by mission instance and target ID, never merely ship type.
persistencePolicy: Every campaign starts unaccepted with its current identity and zero progress. Persist current-format stage evidence, choices, mission-item custody, reward and clue receipts. Resume these records on load; replayed events cannot duplicate rewards. No previous campaign or save format is imported.

completionClue.label: The missing instant
completionClue.journalText: The recovered timing standard contains an interval that none of the lane clocks measured. Inside that interval, a curved trace repeats eight times.

stages.oracleLedgerEvidence: At Enmadan, compare the immutable original recorder with the genuine commission-bound booking corpus. Two customers each paid 50 CR into the conserved 100 CR record. The true intervals [E+600,E+660) and [E+630,E+690) overlap for 30 seconds; clock offsets are 0/+60 seconds and reservation counters 1/2. These are authored booking facts, not player cash or a live convoy deadline. Retain 8 kg original custody and create only zero-mass evidence; no repair, cancellation, cash or clue is awarded at this stage.

custodyRevision.rule: Retain the exact original recorder through the reservation audit, timing-standard collection, lane repair and escort. The timing standard consumes1t at rebuild-lane; the recorder transfers only at close-case with an atomic archive receipt. Data copies have zero mass and cannot replace physical custody. Archive, payment and clue are one final transaction. Loss follows the separate remedial inquiry, without cloning the recorder.

mainQuestContinuity: Original failure remains recorded. A successful separately scoped continuity inquiry can earn this same source clue without its original fee or reward; always requestable through the clue journal/charter orbital desk, independent of money, source stock and original station/witness survival.
